target: UTM bundled QEMU profile, AArch64 PCI, virtio-ramfb, disposable disk
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-span-strut-utm-qemu-2026-11-09.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-span-strut
checks: Span launched, displayed its instructions and graphical bridge view, then Shift+Escape returned to the terminal.
Strut launched, accepted edit/play interaction and displayed graphics; Escape returned to the terminal.
The terminal evaluated 40+2; as 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: This is a headless run using UTM's bundled QEMU profile, not visible UTM app-window or Pi hardware acceptance. Complete bridge construction, physics coverage and persistence in this profile remain unverified.
